themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging the recent migration crisis in Ceuta and broader EU migration policies to rally political support. This theme is marked by intense rhetoric, policy proposals, and public mobilization, with notable parallels in Spain, Italy, Germany, and the UK.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands immediate halt to migrant centers in Oviedo, frames Ceuta crisis as an 'invasion,' and pressures PP to adopt stricter migration policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Praises Italy's border controls and external processing centers, criticizes Spain's response to Ceuta crisis, and aligns with Denmark on stricter EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Uses migration as a key campaign issue, criticizing government policies and advocating for stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes deporting foreign prisoners and tightening immigration policies, linking migration to national security concerns.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes government handling of migration, demands stricter border policies, and highlights economic impacts on local businesses.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes uncontrolled immigration, advocates for stricter border policies, and criticizes EU migration frameworks.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in the U.S., Hungary, and Poland are pushing for restrictive birthright citizenship policies, framing them as essential for national identity and security. This theme reflects a broader transnational effort to redefine citizenship laws.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration proposes executive orders to limit birthright citizenship, targeting 'alien enemies' and birth tourism.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Criticizes past governments for lax immigration policies and advocates for stricter citizenship laws to protect national identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposes policies to limit citizenship rights for foreigners, emphasizing national sovereignty and security concerns.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, Hungary, and the U.S. are pushing for significant cuts to social programs, citing fiscal responsibility and economic reform. This theme highlights a shared approach to austerity and deregulation across borders.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Proposes sweeping cuts to social programs, deregulation, and privatization to address fiscal deficits and economic instability.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Criticizes past governments for overspending on social programs, advocates for fiscal tightening and targeted welfare reforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to Head Start, homelessness funding, and other social programs, emphasizing deregulation and fiscal conservatism.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: The rise of Germany's far-right AfD party is dominating political discourse ahead of key regional elections, with other parties scrambling to respond. This theme captures the party's growing influence and the broader political realignment in Germany.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, forcing other parties to adjust strategies and rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Monitors AfD's rise as a potential model for far-right success, influencing Sweden's political landscape.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Aligns with AfD on migration and EU skepticism, using its success as a blueprint for far-right gains in France.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal divisions and leadership challenges are emerging within right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, and Argentina, threatening their cohesion and electoral prospects. This theme highlights the fragility of right-wing alliances and the struggle for ideological dominance.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces internal splits, with key figures like Morawiecki forming rival factions and challenging party leadership.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Struggles with leadership challenges from Salvini and Vannacci, who advocate for competing visions within the party.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Experiences internal fractures over legislative strategy and alliances, with key figures distancing themselves from Milei's leadership.
